name: Pressure Cooker Pumpkin Spice Oatmeal with Candied Walnuts & Maple Syrup

instructions.primary_message: Place water, milk, maple syrup, pumpkin spice mix, vanilla, and salt in a 6-quart electric pressure cooker insert. Whisk to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup whole milk
pure maple syrup
2 tsp pumpkin spice mix
1 tsp vanilla extract
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Add oats to the insert and stir to combine. Lock lid in place and set valve to the pressure cooking setting.
Set to pressure cook on HIGH for 4 minutes, then allow the pressure to release naturally for 15 minutes. Carefully release any remaining pressure and remove the lid.
Add pumpkin to the insert and stir well to combine the oatmeal.
instructions.secondary_message: ½ (15 oz) can pure pumpkin purée

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide pumpkin oatmeal between bowls; top with walnuts and additional maple syrup. Enjoy!
